purpose: Turn each durable macro estate into one parallel, bounded acquisition lane without promoting research instructions into claims, graph edges, conclusions, or publication state.

lane_policy.unit: one durable issue lane per macro estate
lane_policy.parallelism: all estate lanes may run concurrently; dependencies are enforced only within an estate lane
lane_policy.boundary: Operational priority orders work inside a lane. It is not a ranking of estates, subjects, people, institutions, risk, importance, or wrongdoing.

required_outputs: bounded universe with inclusion and exclusion rules
ordinary, unsuccessful, nonparticipant, or explicit-null controls
denominator_freeze.stopping_rule: Stop when the named universe and controls are fully enumerated, or when every unresolved portion is explicitly partial or unavailable with search provenance.

required_outputs: source bytes, archive, or stable official record identifier
record, filing, instrument, award, case, parcel, or transaction identifiers
coverage window, duplicates, nulls, and access failures
source_acquisition.stopping_rule: Stop when the declared source route is enumerated for the bounded estate window, or when remaining coverage is documented as partial or unavailable without being treated as a negative result.

required_outputs: independently resolved people, organizations, legal entities, vehicles, properties, awards, and instruments
name-only and brand-only matches retained outside promotion
identity_resolution.stopping_rule: Stop when every proposed cross-source join is accepted with independent identifiers, retained as ambiguous, or explicitly rejected; never force a merge to complete the table.

required_outputs: separate event, decision, filing, execution, award, obligation, outlay, performance, publication, and retrieval dates
unsuccessful, withdrawn, denied, nonparticipant, and no-match rows
temporal_and_null_controls.stopping_rule: Stop when temporal order and null controls are sufficient to distinguish pre-positioning, decision windows, performance, and later outcomes, or when remaining order is explicitly unresolved.

required_outputs: contradictions, nulls, unsuccessful paths, and source failures
candidate_packet.stopping_rule: Stop at a candidate-only handoff. No task may create a canonical claim, graph effect, causal conclusion, allegation, report approval, or publication approval.
